items.title: Setting breakpoints in IDEs like PyCharm or VS Code

source_refs.note: Unnumbered topic Setting breakpoints in IDEs like PyCharm or VS Code as printed (PDF 66, printed 62); its own lesson since 2026-10-29 (one lesson per book heading), moved from the Using Breakpoints and Watches lesson.

blocks.text: Breakpoints are markers that pause program execution at a chosen line of code. IDEs like PyCharm and VS Code allow setting breakpoints with a simple click. When the program reaches a breakpoint, execution stops, and the current state can be examined. Breakpoints help focus on specific sections of code without running the entire program.
